label: Participles
description: A 20-question check on the participles lessons.

questions.prompt: In «Идущие домой дети громко смеются», what is «идущие»?
questions.explain: идущие is the present active participle of идти ('going/who are going'), agreeing with дети.

questions.prompt: What does «читающий» mean in «Читающий мальчик сидит у окна»?
options: the boy who was read to
questions.explain: читающий is the present active participle of читать and means the boy who is reading.

questions.prompt: Present active participles like читающий and идущий are built with which suffix?
questions.explain: The present active participle is built from the present stem plus -щ- (the -ущ/-ющ/-ащ/-ящ types).

questions.prompt: The lessons say «Читающая девочка» can be reworded as which который-clause?
questions.explain: The lesson unfolds читающая девочка as девочка, которая читает — the girl who is reading.

questions.prompt: In «Автор, написавший роман, дал интервью», «написавший» is what kind of participle?
questions.explain: написавший is the past active participle of написать — the one who wrote the novel.

questions.prompt: Past active participles from a vowel-final past stem (написал, купил) use which suffix?
questions.explain: From the past stem ending in a vowel you drop -л and add -вш-, as in написавший, купивший.

questions.prompt: Why is «пришедший» formed with -ш- and not -вш-?
options: because its past stem пришёл ends in a consonant
because it is a passive participle
questions.explain: The past stem пришёл ends in a consonant, so the suffix is -ш-, giving пришедший.

questions.prompt: What does «Сотрудник, ушедший на пенсию, счастлив» mean?
options: The employee going into retirement is happy.
The employee who retired is happy.
The employee who will retire is happy.
The retired employee is being congratulated.
questions.explain: ушедший is the past active participle of уйти; the sentence means the employee who left/retired is happy.

questions.prompt: In «Читаемый текст лежит на столе», «читаемый» is best understood as what?
options: the text that is being read
the text that will be read
the person who reads the text
questions.explain: читаемый is the present passive participle of читать — the text that is being read.

questions.prompt: Present passive participles like читаемый and изучаемый are built with which suffix?
questions.explain: Present passive participles use -ем- (1st conjugation) or -им- (2nd conjugation), e.g. читаемый, любимый.

questions.prompt: The lessons note that «любимый» (from любить) has largely become which kind of word?
questions.explain: любимый has lexicalized into the everyday adjective 'beloved/favourite'.

questions.prompt: In «Написанный другом текст был интересным», «написанный» is what kind of participle?
questions.explain: написанный is the past passive participle of написать — the text that was written.

questions.prompt: The past passive participle «написанный» (from написать) uses which suffix?
questions.explain: написанный is formed from the stem написа- plus the suffix -нн- and an adjective ending.

questions.prompt: Past passive participles «открытый» and «закрытый» take which suffix?
questions.explain: открытый and закрытый are built from открыть/закрыть with the suffix -т-.

questions.prompt: In «Письмо было написано вчера вечером», «написано» is which form?
questions.explain: The short form написано joins было to build a past passive: the letter was written.

questions.prompt: In «Эта книга написана известным писателем», what role does «писателем» play?
options: the agent (by whom it was written), in the instrumental
questions.explain: The instrumental писателем names the agent — the writer by whom the book was written.

questions.prompt: What does «Построенная рабочими школа открылась осенью» mean?
options: The school built by the workers opened in autumn.
The school that builds workers opened in autumn.
The workers who built the school opened in autumn.
The school being built will open in autumn.
questions.explain: построенная is the past passive participle of построить; the school built by the workers opened in autumn.

questions.prompt: In «Живущий рядом сосед очень добрый», which noun does «живущий» agree with, and in what gender/number/case?
questions.explain: живущий is masculine singular nominative, agreeing with сосед — the neighbour who lives nearby.

questions.prompt: In «Дверь открыта, можно входить смело», the short form «открыта» agrees with дверь in what way?
questions.explain: The short predicative form открыта agrees only in feminine gender (and number) with дверь — the door is open.

questions.prompt: What does «Уважаемые коллеги, начнём работу» show about «уважаемые»?
options: it is a past active participle
it has lexicalized as a fixed polite address ('dear colleagues')
questions.explain: уважаемые has lexicalized into the fixed polite address meaning 'dear colleagues'.
